title: Truss quality assurance.
officialText:
Trusses not part of a manufacturing process in accordance with either Section
2303.4.6 or a standard listed in Chapter 35, which provides requirements for quality control done under the
supervision of a third-party quality control agency, shall be manufactured in compliance with Sections 1704.2
and 1704.6, as applicable.
